glosses: grove (set of trees, shrubs and other plants, generally smaller than a forest)
woods (land covered with trees, often consisting of only a few plant species)

examples.en: He lost his way in the woods.
She was wandering in the woods.
Tom got lost in the woods.

examples.text: Os ladrões se esconderam no bosque.
examples.en: The thieves hid in the woods.

examples.text: Ele se perdeu enquanto andava no bosque.
examples.en: He got lost while walking in the woods.
